vulnerabilityReview.rationale: Fresh review for Hospital 1.14.0, recorded on 2026-11-23 under the maintainer's instruction. The PostgreSQL source moves from 17.11 to 17.12 (released 2026-11-12): the PostgreSQL security page for version 17 lists 97 advisories and every one has a fix in the 17 line; 17.12 contains the fixes of 47 of them, 30 of CVSS 8.8, which 17.11 did not. zlib moves from 1.3.2 to 1.4 (released 2026-11-04), whose notes list the security fixes of CVE-2026-85091 (a buffer overflow in a non-blocking gzwrite) and of the overruns in inflateGetDictionary, inflatePrime, deflatePrime, inflateBack and inflateSync; its breaking changes concern Windows and CMake builds and the z_off_t default, and the appliance links zlib only into PostgreSQL. ACL 2.4.0 is unchanged: the Debian tracker lists only CVE-2026-54369 and CVE-2026-54370, which the descriptor-relative API of 2.4.0 addresses, and a 2009 entry. The tarball checksums are the PostgreSQL project's published SHA-256 and the SHA-256 GitHub records for the zlib 1.4 release asset. The configure flags, the Debian snapshot and the compiler and builder package records are unchanged; the postgres base image is moved to 17.12-trixie. Source-built PostgreSQL components remain provenance-only because Trivy does not vulnerability-map them; this review is the dated evidence the gate asks for, and the scanner findings without fixes are handled by the exact release-scoped vulnerability exceptions.
